notes.title: HOTFIX1.0.0.2 (UI显示，超级采样，战斗人物消失）（UI,SSAA,missing character)
notes.content:
在研究了问题收集帖之后，我们决定推出紧急修复补丁


修复内容：

1.修复开场战斗中人物描述

2.修复超级采样问题

3.修复天王枪法问题

After researching into the feedback thread ,we have decide to push another patch.
 

FIX:

1.Fixed the UI text in intro battle.

2.Fixed the SSAA option.

3.Fixed the missing character in the intro battle.

notes.title: And we are up!侠客前传正式发售！
notes.content:
Thank you, everyone who supported us in the past years ,without you,this game will not be possible to be released into steam in the first place.


 And we promise there will be more content and fix in the future,we are currently focusing on the future content of the game,all the bugs in the feedback will be dealt with in due time.

Again, thank you everyone who supported Tale of Wuxia:The Pre-Sequel and us
                                                                                                             yours truly
                              HELUO STUDIO&FENGHUANG GAME

武侠梦世界梦！感谢所有支持我们走过这一路的朋友们！没有你们，就不会有侠客风云系列！

此次侠客风云传将会支持中英文双语以及卡片系列，并且我们将会在之后的日子里持续针对内容与bug进行更新修正，希望侠客风云传系列能成为我们走向更广大舞台的敲门石。
最后再次感谢所有一路上支持着我们的所有人，无以为报，只能用更加优秀的作品去呈献给诸位。
                                                                                       河洛工作室&凤凰游戏
